description: This file defines the UpdateTaskCommand class, which handles updating task objects in the Superset project, including locking, security checks, and property updates.

classes.name: UpdateTaskCommand
classes.description: A command class to update a task with concurrency control, security validation, and property management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the command with task UUID, status, timestamps, payload, properties, and security check flag.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the update process with distributed locking, fetching the task, and calling the update logic.

methods.name: _execute_update
methods.description: Performs the actual update of the task, including security validation and property setting.
